verdict.rationale: The axis applies: RingCentral sells phone numbers and supports voice, SMS and MMS. However, nothing in the evidence shows per-number capability flags (voice, SMS, MMS) being displayed during number search or before purchase. The pack only makes general claims about voice and SMS/MMS APIs and mentions local numbers, which are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a founder, each number shows its voice, SMS, and MMS capability before I buy it
